name: Combo amp
definition: instrument amplifier and loudspeaker in one cabinet; circuit technology (tube, solid-state, modelling, hybrid), wattage and speaker size are attributes.
notes: Category sold with tube, solid-state and modelling combos; wattage and speaker size are filters.

name: Amp head
definition: instrument amplifier without a loudspeaker, made to drive a separate cabinet.
notes: Tube, solid-state and hybrid heads sold apart from cabinets; type is a filter.

name: Speaker cabinet
definition: loudspeaker enclosure made to be driven by an amp head.
notes: Straight and slant cabinets plus powered full-range flat-response cabs sold in the same category.

name: Amp modeller
definition: floor or desktop unit that carries amplifier models (usually with effects) in place of an amplifier.
notes: Floor amp modellers and amp and cabinet simulators sold as own categories; usually include effects.

name: Distortion effect
definition: unit that clips the instrument signal hard for a distorted sound; format (pedal, rack, desktop) is an attribute.
notes: Distortion pedals sold as a category; analog, digital and hybrid are filters.

name: Overdrive effect
definition: unit that clips the signal softly to emulate a driven amplifier.
notes: Overdrive pedals sold as a category with distortion and boost; listed under one combined category.

name: Delay effect
definition: unit that repeats the signal after a set time.
notes: Delay sold together with reverb as Reverb and Delay pedals; delay models listed.

name: Multi-effects processor
definition: unit offering several effect types in one housing and no amplifier models.
notes: Page filters amp-modelling units; TC Plethora TonePrint multi-FX shown without amp models; split not shown.

name: Large-diaphragm condenser microphone
definition: condenser microphone with a large capsule, sold for recording music; connectivity (USB, XLR) is an attribute.
notes: Diaphragm size filter; studio and podcast uses shown; polar pattern is a filter.

name: Dynamic microphone
definition: moving-coil microphone sold for music on stage or in the studio.
notes: Moving-coil mics; XLR and USB connectors are filters; uses include vocal, drum and instrument.

name: Wireless microphone system
definition: microphone or bodypack transmitter with its receiver, sold for music performance.
notes: Handheld wireless mic systems; lavalier and headset systems are separate categories.

name: Audio interface
definition: external unit that converts microphone and instrument signals for recording music on a computer (K-150).
notes: USB audio interfaces sold with desktop, rackmount and portable form factors.

name: Mixer
definition: console that combines, levels and routes several audio channels; analogue or digital and channel count are attributes.
notes: Live sound mixers split into analog, digital and powered mixers; channel count is a filter.

name: Studio monitor
definition: near-field loudspeaker cabinet made for monitoring in recording and mixing.
notes: Studio monitors split into active, passive, subwoofers and surround systems.

name: PA speaker
definition: pole-mount or flown loudspeaker cabinet made for live sound; powered or passive is an attribute.
notes: PA speakers filtered powered or passive; self-powered and passive cabinets both sold.

name: Studio headphones
definition: headphones sold by their maker as studio, stage or DJ equipment.
notes: Headphones with studio monitoring, DJ and open-back series; wired or wireless is a filter.

name: In-ear monitor system
definition: stage in-ear monitoring kit with a transmitter and a bodypack receiver (K-143); provisional until attested.
notes: In-Ear Monitor Systems is its own category beside earphones and transmitters and receivers.

name: DI box
definition: direct-input box that converts an instrument signal to a balanced microphone-level signal.
notes: Direct boxes filtered active or passive; Radial, ProCo and Rupert Neve boxes listed.

name: DJ controller
definition: control surface with jog wheels, faders and pads for DJ software.
notes: DJ controllers with software filters Serato, rekordbox and Traktor; standalone units included.

name: DJ turntable
definition: direct-drive record turntable sold for DJ performance.
notes: DJ turntables sold as direct-drive turntables; belt drive described as the home type.

name: MIDI keyboard controller
definition: keyboard that makes no sound of its own and sends MIDI or other control data to sound sources.
notes: MIDI controllers typed keyboard, pad, wind, foot and keytar; keyboard type has most listings.

name: Pad controller
definition: grid or bank of pads that sends control data to software or hardware, for beat-making, recording or DJing alike.
notes: Pad type in MIDI Controllers (24) and separate drum controllers and multipads category.

name: Guitar strings
definition: set or single string made for a guitar or bass.
notes: Electric guitar strings by brand and series; string count, winding and gauge are filters.

name: Guitar case
definition: hard or soft case made to hold one guitar or bass.
notes: Gig bags listed; hard cases are a linked sibling category under Guitar Cases and Bags.

name: Drumstick
definition: stick made for playing drums and cymbals, sold as a pair.
notes: Drumsticks and brushes by wood, tip material and size (5A, 5B, 7A).

name: Music stand
definition: stand that holds sheet music or a tablet at reading height for the player.
notes: Music stands split collapsible and non-collapsible; symphony-style and folding stands sold.

name: Metronome
definition: device that sounds or shows a steady, settable beat.
notes: Metronomes by format: wearable, handheld, desktop and clip-on.

name: Tuner
definition: device that shows how far a played note is from the target pitch.
notes: Tuners by format clip-on, pedal, handheld; chromatic, strobe and polyphonic types.

name: Practice mute
definition: mute that quiets an instrument for practice, made for several instruments.
notes: Practice mutes listed per instrument: trumpet, flugel, horns, euphonium, trombone, tuba.
